text.en:
(a) The paragraph headed "Bureau of Constabulary" of section one of Act Numbered
Twenty-two hundred and eight is hereby amended to read as follows :
"BUREAU OF CONSTABULARY.
"For salaries and wages and duly authorized contingent expenses of the Bureau of Constabulary, including
maintenance and repair of Insular buildings, for use in the Moro Province, the Mountain Province, and the
Provinces of Agusan and Nueva Vizcaya, nine hundred and eighty thousand pesos.
"The appointment in the manner and at the salaries provided by law of one additional lieutenant-colonel and
assistant director, one additional major, three additional captains, five additional first lieutenants, and five
additional second lieutenants is hereby authorized."
(b) The last paragraph of said section is hereby amended to read as follows:
"Total of appropriations for all purposes except for the Bureau of Forestry, one million six hundred and
eighty-seven thousand five hundred pesos."
